hooks.command: input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$path" in *.cpp|*.h|*.c|*.ino|*platformio.ini) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pio run -e wiscore_rak4631 -e wiscore_rak4631-noble >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'build FAILED — both envs must pass. The no-BLE env is the flash fallback; if it rots it is not a fallback.' >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
